source.note: Hit keys reconciled 2026-10-04 with Genshin Optimizer's Vodyanitsa sheet (frzyc/genshin-optimizer PR #3316, branch van/go/7.1): burst dmg -> burst skillDmg. burst.songOfAgesPastDmg has no GO counterpart (GO applies Song of Ages Past as a conditional on burst.skillDmg) and is kept as our own key. Original note: Added 2026-09-22 (7.1 release day); Amber/yatta and Genshin Optimizer had no entry yet, so hit keys are GUESSES in GO's vocabulary, to be reconciled once GO ships a Vodyanitsa sheet: normal 0-3 (catalyst, Hydro), charged dmg, plunging dmg/low/high, skill skillDmg (Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn, % Max HP) + hornDmg (Horn of Spring's Call, % Max HP, one instance per 3s attack), burst dmg (Koda: Sink With Thee, % Max HP). The burst's 'Song of Ages Past DMG Bonus' (86.4% at Lv10, 102% at Lv13) is ADDITIVE TO THE RATIO, not a DMG% bonus, so it is a second hit key burst.songOfAgesPastDmg = 82.2% + 86.4% = 168.6% Max HP (197.1% boosted); score burst.dmg only for a cast outside Song of Ages Past. Healing is not modelled. A4 Lead Vocal / Chorus: the hyperlink glossary's {PARAM#P1402201|3S1}..|7S1} refs resolve to passive param_list[2..6] = 40000 / 260 / 140 / 6500 / 3500 with the S1 (raw) format, i.e. a flat DMG increase per 1,000 Max HP above 40,000, NOT a percentage -- see the a4LeadVocal* conditionals. Not tagged enables=stellar: she does not create Stellar reactions herself (she turns a Stellar Vortex into a Wandering Vortex and extends Radiance). 2026-10-06: added GO's six A4 display nodes as stat-readout rotation targets (passive2.a4LeadVocal_/a4Chorus_ x hydro_/cryo_/stellarswirl_dmgIncDisp). Each scores the flat DMG increase ONE quill stack adds, min(max(Max HP - 40000, 0) x 0.14 (0.26 Stellar Swirl), 3500 (6500)), read off the scored build's own buffed Max HP; weight = stacks consumed. Lead Vocal and Chorus read the same value (GO's split is active vs off-field consumer).

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A4 Dirge of the Fandyr, SELF half: using her Elemental Skill grants 25 Lead Vocal stacks (30s); each Hydro/Cryo Normal/Charged/Plunging/Skill/Burst hit by the active character consumes one and its DMG is increased by a flat 140 per 1,000 Max HP VODYANITSA has above 40,000, capped at 3,500 (reached at 65,000 HP). Offered only when she is the scored character: the hydro_dmgInc_from_maxHp_excess40000_ conversion reads the build's own post-buff Max HP (so it sees C4's stacks), and her own hits are all Hydro. Continuous rather than stepped per 1,000. While a Wandering Vortex is present (or for 5s after one explodes) the stacks only trigger on Stellar Swirl DMG, which she does not deal -- leave this off for such a rotation. When she is a teammate, use the a4LeadVocal*SourceHp inputs instead.

C1 Waters in Full Splendor, SELF half: each Song of Ages Past healing tick also increases all nearby party members' ATK by 0.8% of Vodyanitsa's Max HP for 5s (ticks every 1.5s, so effectively permanent while the skill is up). When she is the scored character this is her own build's HP: atk_from_maxHp_ reads it live. Teammates use c1SongOfAgesPastSourceHp.

C4 Melancholic Voice Upon the Gentle Waters: each Song of Ages Past healing tick on a character at 40% HP or above increases Vodyanitsa's Max HP by 20% for 6s, up to 3 independent stacks (the below-40% branch is +50% healing, not modelled). Feeds her HP-scaling hits and every '% of her Max HP' buff. Pick the average stack count.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn — the skill hit and every Horn of Spring's Call attack decrease the Hydro RES and Cryo RES of opponents hit by 30% for 6s at skill Lv10 (35.4% from C3, where the skill reaches Lv13). The Horn attacks every 3s over 16s, so the shred is effectively permanent while Song of Ages Past is active. In a team that triggers Skirk's Mutual Weapons Mentorship (every member Hydro or Cryo, at least one of each) the builder switches 'on' to the '+1 Skill level' state automatically (talentLevelStates.skill), which takes the skill to Lv11 / Lv14: the shred grows on its own 6%-per-level curve rather than the 1/18 the skill's DMG multipliers use, so it needs this explicit state. The matching boost to the skill's DAMAGE needs no conditional: the builder records the +1 on the board and the evaluator reads her levelUp multipliers.

A1 The Last Djeguako Songstress: using her Elemental Skill turns any Stellar Vortex on the field into a Wandering Vortex, and while Song of Ages Past is active the party's Stellar Swirl reactions generate Wandering Vortexes instead. Generating or detonating a Wandering Vortex reduces nearby opponents' Anemo RES by 35% for 6s. (The A1 also extends a party member's Radiance: Stellar Swirl state by 4s -- uptime, not a modifier.)

C2 Echoes That Pierce the Snow: each Horn of Spring's Call attack grants 'Two Voices in Black and White' for 5s (Horn attacks every 3s, so permanent while the skill is up) to the currently active party member -- at C6 to all nearby party members. Without a Wandering Vortex it is +50% CRIT DMG on the Hydro DMG and Cryo DMG they deal; while a Wandering Vortex is present (or for 5s after one explodes) it becomes +60% CRIT DMG on Stellar Swirl reaction DMG instead. Pick the state matching the rotation. Team scope: the scored character is assumed to be the active one, or C6 to be in play.

states.value: Stellar Swirl CRIT DMG +60% (Wandering Vortex up)

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: C6 Neverending Song of Revelry: while Song of Ages Past is active, Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is ELEVATED by 25% (its own (1 + Elevation) bracket, stellarswirl_specialDmg_, same as Sandrone's C6 for Stellar-Conduct) and Hydro DMG and Cryo DMG dealt are increased by 60%. The C6 also extends C2's crit buff to the whole party, which c2TwoVoicesCritDmg already assumes.

others_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A4 Dirge of the Fandyr, OTHERS half, Stellar Swirl mode: her Elemental Skill grants 25 Lead Vocal stacks (consumed by the active character) and 10 Chorus stacks (consumed by off-field party members), 30s. While a Wandering Vortex is present or for 5s after one explodes -- which is the normal state of a Stellar Swirl team once she has cast her skill, see A1 -- a stack is consumed only by Stellar Swirl reaction DMG, which is increased by a flat 260 per 1,000 Max HP VODYANITSA has above 40,000, capped at 6,500 (reached at 65,000 HP). Type her Max HP; blank assumes 50,000 (= +2,600). Lands on stellarswirl_dmgInc, the Reaction Additive Base DMG slot outside the Stellar brackets. Continuous rather than stepped per 1,000, and the 25/10-stack pool is not enforced -- split the rotation with per-target bonusStats if it has more Stellar Swirl instances than stacks. Mutually exclusive with the Hydro/Cryo entry: in-game only one of the two modes is active at a time.

A4 Dirge of the Fandyr, OTHERS half, Hydro/Cryo mode (no Wandering Vortex on the field, i.e. a team that does not make Stellar Swirl): each Hydro or Cryo Normal/Charged/Plunging/Skill/Burst hit consumes a Lead Vocal (active character) or Chorus (off-field) stack and is increased by a flat 140 per 1,000 Max HP VODYANITSA has above 40,000, capped at 3,500 (reached at 65,000 HP). Type her Max HP; blank assumes 50,000 (= +1,400). Lands on hydro_dmgInc / cryo_dmgInc, so only Hydro and Cryo hits collect it. Continuous rather than stepped per 1,000; the stack pool is not enforced. Mutually exclusive with the Stellar Swirl entry.

C1 Waters in Full Splendor, OTHERS half: each Song of Ages Past healing tick (every 1.5s while her skill is up) increases all nearby party members' ATK by 0.8% of VODYANITSA's Max HP for 5s. Type her Max HP; blank assumes 50,000 (= +400 flat ATK).

auto.name: Psyshkhwe Arietta
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Sings an ancient song of the Water Imps, unleashing up to 4 strikes. This deals <e:hydro>Hydro DMG</e> to the opponent.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a water ball forward, dealing <e:hydro>Hydro DMG</e>.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals <e:hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</e> upon impact with the ground.

skill.name: Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn
skill.desc:
Reveals her true Water Imp form, dealing <e:hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</e> and gaining the <k>Song of Ages Past</k> effect: While this effect is active, Vodyanitsa summons the ancient <k>Horn of Spring's Call</k>, periodically moving closer to an opponent in a swift movement to attack them, dealing <e:hydro>Hydro DMG</e>.
The above two types of attacks will also decrease the <e:hydro>Hydro RES</e> and <e:cryo>Cryo RES</e> of opponents hit. Additionally, while the <k>Song of Ages Past</k> effect is active, the party's active character gains increased resistance to interruption and periodically regenerates HP based on Vodyanitsa's Max HP.

burst.name: Koda: Sink With Thee
burst.desc:
Leads a song of the Water Imps which lures its listeners to their doom. This deals <e:hydro>AoE Hydro DMG</e> to the opponent.
When in the <k>Song of Ages Past</k> state, DMG dealt is further increased.

passives.name: The Last Djeguako Songstress
passives.desc:
When the Elemental Skill <k>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</k> is used, any Stellar Vortex on the field will turn into a Wandering Vortex instead. While the <k>Song of Ages Past</k> effect is active, nearby party members' Stellar Swirl reactions will generate Wandering Vortex instead.
Generating or detonating a Wandering Vortex will also reduce nearby opponents' <e:anemo>Anemo RES</e> by 35% for 6s.
Additionally, nearby party members who enter the <k>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</k> state while <k>Song of Ages Past</k> is in effect will have the <k>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</k> state extended by 4s.

passives.name: Dirge of the Fandyr
passives.desc:
When the Elemental Skill <k>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</k> is used, Vodyanitsa will also gain 25 stacks of <k>Lead Vocal</k> as well as 10 stacks of <k>Chorus</k>.
The two effects above last 30s each, and the stack count is refreshed when the Elemental Skill is used.

passives.name: Echoes Over the Frozen Lake
passives.desc:
Holding the Elemental Skill outside of combat will cause Vodyanitsa to embody her true Water Imp form and swim for up to 10s at the cost of Stamina. Naturally, as a Water Imp, she can also move across the water's surface. Vodyanitsa will exit her Water Imp form when the Elemental Skill is used again, when the duration ends, or when all Stamina is depleted.
Additionally, while Vodyanitsa can swim faster, her Stamina consumption rate is also increased.

passives.name: Heartless Siren Song
passives.desc: As the Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe, Vodyanitsa sings in person in place of playing an instrument.

constellations.name: Waters in Full Splendor
constellations.desc: Each time Vodyanitsa triggers the healing effect of <k>Song of Ages Past</k>, it also increases the ATK of all nearby party members by 0.8% of her Max HP for 5s.

constellations.name: Echoes That Pierce the Snow
constellations.desc:
When the <k>Horn of Spring's Call</k> from the Elemental Skill <k>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</k> attacks the opponent, Vodyanitsa gains the "Two Voices in Black and White" effect which increases the CRIT DMG from <e:hydro>Hydro DMG</e> and <e:cryo>Cryo DMG</e> dealt by the currently active party member by 50% for 5s.
If there is a Wandering Vortex present on the field or in the 5s after a Wandering Vortex explodes, the effect changes to: increases the CRIT DMG from Stellar Swirl reaction DMG caused by the currently active party member by 60% for 5s.
Additionally, the Elemental Skill <k>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</k> is enhanced as follows: the duration of the <k>Song of Ages Past</k> effect is extended by 9s.

constellations.name: Song Lingering on a Spring Morning
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <k>Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Melancholic Voice Upon the Gentle Waters
constellations.desc:
When Vodyanitsa triggers the healing effect of <k>Song of Ages Past</k>, an additional effect will be triggered based on the healed character's HP.
· If the character's HP is below 40%: The healing is increased by 50%; and
· If the character's HP is 40% or above: Vodyanitsa's Max HP is increased by 20% for 6s. Max 3 stacks, and each stack's duration is counted independently.

constellations.name: Together, Down Into the Deep
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst <k>Koda: Sink With Thee</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Neverending Song of Revelry
constellations.desc:
The Constellation <k>Echoes That Pierce the Snow</k> is enhanced: "Two Voices in Black and White" now applies to all nearby party members.
Additionally, while the <k>Song of Ages Past</k> effect is active, Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is <k>elevated</k> by 25% while <e:hydro>Hydro DMG</e> and <e:cryo>Cryo DMG</e> dealt are increased by 60%.

auto.name: Arietta de psyshkhwe
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Chante un chant ancestral des diableautins et enchaîne jusqu'à 4 attaques qui infligent des <e:hydro>DGT Hydro</e>.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance pour lancer une boule d'eau en avant, infligeant des <e:hydro>DGT Hydro</e>.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des <e:hydro>DGT Hydro de zone</e> à l'impact.

skill.name: Rechitativ : Aube sonore
skill.desc:
Vodyanitsa révèle sa véritable forme de diableautine, infligeant des <e:hydro>DGT Hydro de zone</e> et obtenant l'effet <k>Chant d'antan</k> : pendant sa durée, Vodyanitsa invoque un ancien <k>cor du printemps</k> qui se rapproche rapidement d'un ennemi proche de façon intermittente afin de l'attaquer et de lui infliger des <e:hydro>DGT Hydro</e>.
La <e:hydro>RÉS Hydro</e> et la <e:cryo>RÉS Cryo</e> des ennemis touchés par ces types d'attaque diminue. De plus, pendant la durée du <k>chant d'antan</k>, la RÉS à l'interruption de vos personnages déployés augmente et ils récupèrent périodiquement des PV selon les PV max de Vodyanitsa.

burst.name: Koda : Coule avec toi
burst.desc:
Entonne un chant des diableautins qui attire ses auditeurs vers leur perte, infligeant des <e:hydro>DGT Hydro de zone</e>.
De plus, les DGT infligés pendant le <k>chant d'antan</k> augmentent davantage.

passives.name: La dernière compositrice de djeguako
passives.desc:
Utiliser la compétence élémentaire <k>Rechitativ : Aube sonore</k> convertit les vortex stellaires sur le terrain en vortex errants et permet aux personnages de l'équipe à proximité de créer des vortex errants à la place des vortex stellaires lorsqu'ils déclenchent des réactions d'Astrodispersion pendant la durée d'un <k>chant d'antan</k>.
Lorsqu'un vortex errant est créé ou explose, les <e:anemo>DGT Anémo</e> des ennemis proches diminuent également de 35 % pendant 6 s.
De plus, lorsqu'un personnage de l'équipe à proximité passe en <k>radiance « Astrodispersion »</k> pendant la durée d'un <k>chant d'antan</k>, la durée de la <k>radiance « Astrodispersion »</k> augmente de 4 s.

passives.name: Chant funèbre du fandyr
passives.desc:
Utiliser la compétence élémentaire <k>Rechitativ : Aube sonore</k> accorde 25 cumuls de <k>chant principal</k> et 10 cumuls de <k>chœur</k> à Vodyanitsa.
Ces effets durent 30 s et les cumuls sont actualisés en utilisant à nouveau la compétence élémentaire.

passives.name: Échos sur le lac gelé
passives.desc:
Hors combat, utiliser sa compétence élémentaire avec un appui long permet à Vodyanitsa de révéler sa véritable forme de diableautine et de nager pendant 10 s en consommant de l'endurance. Étant une diableautine, Vodyanitsa peut également se déplacer sur la surface de l'eau. Vodyanitsa reprend son apparence normale en utilisant à nouveau sa compétence élémentaire, à la fin de la durée ou une fois son endurance épuisée.
De plus, Vodyanitsa nage plus vite, mais consomme son endurance plus rapidement.

passives.name: Chant de sirène sans cœur
passives.desc: Vodyanitsa, première soprano de la Troupe Korolevskiy, chantera de sa propre voix au lieu de jouer d'un instrument de musique.

constellations.name: Eaux dans toute leur splendeur
constellations.desc: Chaque fois que Vodyanitsa déclenche l'effet de soin d'un <k>chant d'antan</k>, l'ATQ de tous les personnages de l'équipe à proximité augmente d'une valeur équivalant à 0,8 % de ses PV max pendant 5 s.

constellations.name: Échos qui percent la neige
constellations.desc:
Lorsque le <k>cor du printemps</k> de la compétence élémentaire <k>Rechitativ : Aube sonore</k> attaque un ennemi, Vodyanitsa obtient l'effet Deux voix en noir et blanc : augmente les DGT CRIT des <e:hydro>DGT Hydro</e> et des <e:cryo>DGT Cryo</e> du personnage déployé de 50 % pendant 5 s.
Si un vortex errant est présent sur le terrain et pendant les 5 s suivant l'explosion d'un vortex errant, cet effet est converti pour augmenter les DGT CRIT des DGT de réaction d'Astrodispersion du personnage déployé de 60 % pendant 5 s.
De plus, la compétence élémentaire <k>Rechitativ : Aube sonore</k> est renforcée : la durée du <k>chant d'antan</k> augmente de 9 s.

constellations.name: Chant persistant un matin de printemps
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Rechitativ : Aube sonore</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Voix mélancolique sur les eaux calmes
constellations.desc:
Lorsque Vodyanitsa déclenche l'effet de soin d'un <k>chant d'antan</k>, différents effets sont appliqués selon les PV du personnage soigné :
· S'il a moins de 40 % de PV, le soin augmente de 50 %.
· S'il a 40 % de PV ou plus, les PV max de Vodyanitsa augmentent de 20 % pendant 6 s. Cet effet peut être cumulé 3 fois maximum, la durée de chaque cumul étant calculée de façon indépendante.

constellations.name: Ensemble, au fond des profondeurs
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Koda : Coule avec toi</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Chant de réjouissances sans fin
constellations.desc:
La constellation <k>Échos qui percent la neige</k> est renforcée : l'effet Deux voix en noir et blanc est converti pour s'appliquer à tous les personnages de l'équipe à proximité.
De plus, pendant un <k>chant d'antan</k>, les DGT de réaction d'Astrodispersion des personnages de l'équipe à proximité bénéficient d'une <k>élévation</k> de 25 % et leurs <e:hydro>DGT Hydro</e> et <e:cryo>DGT Cryo</e> augmentent de 60 %.

auto.name: Ária das Águas
auto.desc:
<k>Ataque Normal</k>
Canta uma canção antiga das sereias, realizando até 4 ataques, infligindo <e:hydro>Dano Hydro</e>.

<k>Ataque Carregado</k>
Consome uma certa quantidade de Stamina para disparar uma bola d'água <e:hydro>Dano Hydro</e>.

<k>Ataque Imersivo</k>
Mergulha ao chão em pleno ar, infligindo dano a todos os inimigos em seu caminho. Inflige <e:hydro>Dano Hydro em uma AdE</e> durante o impacto com o chão.

skill.name: Recitativo: Alvorada Sonora
skill.desc:
Revela sua verdadeira forma de Sereia, causando <e:hydro>Dano Hydro em uma AdE</e> e obtendo o efeito <k>Canção de Outrora</k>: enquanto esse efeito estiver ativo, Vodyanitsa invocará o antigo <k>Berrante da Primavera</k>, que periodicamente avançará com rapidez em direção a um inimigo para atacá-lo, causando <e:hydro>Dano Hydro</e>.
Os dois tipos de ataque mencionados acima também reduzem a <e:hydro>RES Hydro</e> e a <e:cryo>RES Cryo</e> dos inimigos atingidos. Além disso, enquanto o efeito <k>Canção de Outrora</k> estiver ativo, o personagem ativo da equipe terá sua Resistência contra Interrupção aumentada e recuperará Vida periodicamente com base na Vida Máxima de Vodyanitsa.

burst.name: Finalização: Afundando Contigo
burst.desc:
Entoa a canção das sereias, que atrai quem a escuta para as profundezas, causando <e:hydro>Dano Hydro em AdE</e>.
Quando estiver no estado <k>Canção de Outrora</k>, aumenta ainda mais o Dano causado.

passives.name: Último Poeta
passives.desc:
Ao lançar a Habilidade Elemental <k>Recitativo: Alvorada Sonora</k>, faz o Vórtice do Vento Estelar ativo mudar para Vórtice Flutuante, e para personagens próximos da equipe que estejam sob a duração do efeito <k>Canção de Outrora</k>, ao desencadearem Redemoinho Estelar, passarão a criar um Vórtice Flutuante que substitui o Vórtice do Vento Estelar.
Ao criar ou explodir um Vórtice Flutuante, reduz a <e:anemo>RES Anemo</e> dos inimigos próximos em 35% por 6s.
Além disso, na duração de <k>Canção de Outrora</k>, quando um personagem próximo entrar em <k>Brilho Reluzente: Redemoinho Estelar</k>, a duração de <k>Brilho Reluzente: Redemoinho Estelar</k> é prolongada em 4s.

passives.name: Lágrimas das Doze Cordas
passives.desc:
Ao lançar a Habilidade Elemental <k>Recitativo: Alvorada Sonora</k>, Vodyanitsa obtém 25 acúmulos de <k>Primeira Cantora</k> e 10 acúmulos de <k>Concerto</k>.
Esses efeitos duram 30s cada, e são redefinidos ao lançar a Habilidade Elemental novamente.

passives.name: Ecos do Lago Congelado
passives.desc:
Quando não está em combate, ao manter pressionada a Habilidade Elemental, Vodyanitsa revela sua forma de Sereia e consumindo Stamina, nada até 10s. É óbvio que ela pode nadar na água, já que é uma Sereia. Ao lançar a Habilidade Elemental novamente, quando a Duração acabar ou a Stamina acabar, Vodyanitsa não manterá mais sua forma de Sereia.
Além disso, aumenta a velocidade de nado de Vodyanitsa, mas também aumenta a velocidade de consumo de Stamina.

passives.name: Música Desalmada da Sereia
passives.desc: Como a prima donna da Companhia Korolevskiy, quando Vodyanitsa toca um instrumento, mudará para ela mesma cantar.

constellations.name: Águas Esplendorosas
constellations.desc: Sempre que Vodyanitsa aciona o efeito de cura de <k>Canção de Outrora</k>, o ATQ de todos os membros da equipe próximos também é aumentado em 0,8% da Vida Máx. dela por 5s.

constellations.name: Ecos Perfuradores da Neve
constellations.desc:
Quando atacar o inimigo com <k>Berrante da Primavera</k> da Habilidade Elemental <k>Recitativo: Alvorada Sonora</k>, Vodyanitsa obtém o efeito "Notas da Escuridão e Claridade", aumentando o Dano CRIT <e:hydro>Hydro</e> e <e:cryo>Cryo</e> em 50% para o personagem ativo por 5s.
Se houver um Vórtice Flutuante ativo, ou se dentro dos 5s após o Vórtice Flutuante explodir, ao invés disso, aumentará o Dano CRIT de Redemoinho Estelar do personagem ativo em 60% por 5s.
Além disso, a Habilidade Elemental <k>Recitativo: Alvorada Sonora</k> é fortalecida: a duração do efeito <k>Canção de Outrora</k> é estendida em 9s.

constellations.name: Canção de uma Manhã Primaveril
constellations.desc:
Aumenta o nível da Habilidade Elemental <k>Recitativo: Alvorada Sonora</k> em 3.
O nível máximo de elevação é 15.

constellations.name: Voz Melancólica Sobre Águas Serenas
Juntos Mergulhamos nas Profundezas
constellations.desc:
Aumenta o nível do Supremo <k>Finalização: Afundando Contigo</k> em 3.
O nível máximo de elevação é 15.

constellations.name: Canção Eterna do Júbilo
constellations.desc:
O efeito da Constelação <k>Ecos Perfuradores da Neve</k> é fortalecido: Notas da Escuridão e Claridade agora afeta todos os membros próximos da equipe.
Além disso, na duração do efeito <k>Canção de Outrora</k>, <k>Eleva</k> o Dano de Redemoinho Estelar causado pelos personagens próximos em 25%, aumenta o <e:hydro>Dano Hydro</e> e <e:cryo>Dano Cryo</e> causado em 60%.
